(set-logic QF_NRA)
(set-option :produce-unsat-cores true)
(set-option :produce-models true)

(declare-const computed_gross_profit_fy2025 Real)
(declare-const cost_of_goods_and_services_sold_fy2025 Real)
(declare-const revenues_fy2025 Real)

(assert (! (= cost_of_goods_and_services_sold_fy2025 18397) :named evidence_cost_of_goods_and_services_sold_fy2025))
(assert (! (= revenues_fy2025 47941) :named evidence_revenues_fy2025))
